content:
This is actually pretty normal behavior in Thunderbird! Bold messages in your Sent folder simply means those messages have not been opened/read yet after sending.

In Thunderbird, bold = unread in any folder — including Sent. Once you click on that message to open it, it will go back to normal (non-bold) text.

If you want to mark them all as read at once:

Click on your Sent folder Right click on it Select "Mark Folder as Read" All bold messages will become normal instantly ✅

To stop this from happening automatically in future:

Go to Edit → Preferences (or Tools → Settings) Click on "General" Look for "Mark messages as read" option You can set it to mark messages as read automatically after a few seconds

That's really all it is — nothing wrong with your Thunderbird, just how it displays unread messages! 😊

Hope that helps!
